positioning: Tawdheef — Auto Job Apply & Application Tracker
qualifier: Free, open-source software is visible in the supporting sentence; no separate badge.
heroHierarchy: Centered headline: Auto-apply to jobs. Track your applications.
One paragraph: Free, open-source software for you and your ChatGPT or Claude agent, with original marks inline.
One black Get the free app primary action to the setup guide and a plain See how it works link.
One unboxed LinkedIn byline: supplied portrait, Built by Ahmed AlDhraif and original LinkedIn favicon square without registered-mark artwork.
heroDecision: The owner approved explicit auto-apply and application-tracking positioning. The exact category stays in naming/search context; natural sentences lead the centered hero. Retain one paragraph, no badge, separate audience row, stacked client captions, Founder of Tabbio line or duplicate central ta mark. Auto-apply is a user-started run through the person's own local agent and authorized connections; no universal, unattended or guaranteed-success claim. This is an owner decision, not measured conversion evidence.

operatingBoundaries.localClient: Codex or Claude Code supplies the local agent; browser ChatGPT/Claude chats do not read local stdio configuration.
operatingBoundaries.authorization: Only an explicit named application run authorizes sending or submission; sign-ins, CAPTCHA, provider approvals and LinkedIn steps may need the person.
operatingBoundaries.cv: Directory browsing/manual tracking does not require Tabbio. Run requires a connected readable Tabbio CV; broader Tabbio CLI/MCP editing remains separate.
operatingBoundaries.costs: Tawdheef code is free and MIT licensed. The user's AI client, model use and connected providers may have separate costs or limits.
operatingBoundaries.outcomes: Record real receipts/confirmations, inspect unknown submissions before retrying, and keep drafts/uploads/talent pools distinct from applied.

informationArchitecture.decision: Owner-approved Guides, About and actual-product walkthrough, inspired by reviewed OpenSEO documentation patterns. Preserve the centered hero, approved wording, brand assets and GitHub-first setup.
informationArchitecture.home: Keep the simple marketing promise, real product view, walkthrough, free Tabbio CV path and country packs. The walkthrough uses real UI without invented account or application state.

informationArchitecture.existingDestinations: Preserve Skills, Directories, GitHub and policies; link task guides to the existing actual skill instead of inventing a catalog of new skills.
informationArchitecture.contentContract: Guides distinguish instructions from tools, installation from authentication and evidence from intent. Explain what the person provides, what is saved, what requires consent and where to go next.
informationArchitecture.releaseBoundary: The live v0.1.1 release assets remain versioned snapshots. New website/source documentation can ship through reviewed GitHub changes without implying old ZIPs were replaced.
informationArchitecture.evidenceLimit: Reference patterns and owner approval are design inputs, not conversion, adoption, ranking or citation evidence.
